datasets.name: Crystallography Open Database (COD)
datasets.description: Open CIF collection spanning inorganic, organic, metal-organic and mineral crystals.
datasets.count_scope: Live COD mirror counter; latest deposition shown 2026-10-23

sources.title: COD official mirror
sources.evidence: Shows 535025 entries, crystal-family coverage excluding biopolymers, and CC0 public-domain dedication.

caveats: Entries are database records, not deduplicated compositions or independently validated new materials.
Scope and data quality must be checked per CIF; reference patterns calculated from CIFs are not measured XRD.

datasets.name: Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD)
datasets.description: Curated inorganic crystal structures with experimental and separately searchable theoretical collections.
datasets.count_scope: Entire ICSD total announced 2026-10-30, including theoretical structures

sources.title: ICSD home
sources.evidence: News dated 30.10.2026 reports 347,985 crystal structures.

sources.title: About ICSD
sources.evidence: Theoretical structures are included and can be searched separately from experimental structures.

sources.title: ICSD products
sources.evidence: Provides licensed Web and desktop access options.

caveats: The headline count is not an experimental-only count.
Free individual deposited structures via CCDC/FIZ Access Structures do not establish bulk redistribution rights.

datasets.name: Cambridge Structural Database (CSD)
datasets.description: Curated experimental three-dimensional organic and metal-organic crystal structures.
datasets.count_scope: Sum of 63 rows in official Structures column, publications 1923–2026, cutoff 2026-01-01; not a November live counter

sources.title: CCDC CSD Publication Year Statistics, 1 January 2026
sources.evidence: Summing 63 published-structure counts gives 1431347. Source marks 2025 as incomplete at the January-2026 cutoff; atom averages are a different column.

sources.title: CCDC: Access Structures downloads
sources.evidence: Individual CIF downloads are free after accepting conditions of use.

sources.title: CCDC/FIZ Access Structures
sources.evidence: Distinguishes free retrieval from advanced licensed CSD-Core and ICSD functionality.

caveats: Count is an explicitly computed sum of the provider publication-year table, not an independently deduplicated or live November-2026 total.
Individual retrieval is free; advanced curated database products require licences.
Calculated non-CSD depositions are outside the curated experimental CSD remit.

datasets.name: American Mineralogist Crystal Structure Database (AMCSD)
datasets.description: Published mineral and synthetic-phase structure refinements with coordinates, cells, symmetry and references.
datasets.count_scope: Current AMCSD collection; no current primary total verified

sources.title: RRUFF FAQ: AMCSD
sources.evidence: Identifies AMCSD as peer-reviewed mineral and synthetic-phase crystallographic refinements.

sources.title: RRUFF: ZIP download
sources.evidence: AMCSD archives include full structural .amc and minimal CIF files.

caveats: Do not infer a permissive data licence from free ZIP availability.
Overlaps mineral structures in COD and data linked to RRUFF specimens.

datasets.name: MAGNDATA
datasets.description: Published commensurate and incommensurate magnetic structures with atomic positions and magnetic moments in magCIF.
datasets.count_scope: Landing-page lower bound, not an enumerated release

sources.title: MAGNDATA landing page
sources.evidence: Reports more than 2000 structures and downloadable .mcif information defining positions and moments.

sources.title: MAGNDATA bulk download instructions
sources.evidence: Bulk repository download requires an approved account; currently academic or educational institutions only.

caveats: Individual entries are downloadable; bulk access has registration and institutional restrictions.
Magnetic structures may be multiple measurements or phases of one composition.

datasets.name: Pearson's Crystal Data
datasets.description: Critically evaluated inorganic structural datasets rooted in PAULING FILE.
datasets.count_scope: 2023/24 offline release; not a live ASM-MPDS total

sources.title: Pearson's Crystal Data publisher page
sources.evidence: 2023/24 release has about 395000 structural datasets; announces transition to ASM online MPDS after final offline release.

caveats: Some datasets lack determined atom coordinates.
Shares PAULING FILE provenance with MPDS and related products; counts are not additive.
Publisher page is historical; future access is directed to ASM MPDS.

datasets.name: Materials Platform for Data Science (MPDS / PAULING FILE)
datasets.description: Literature-curated inorganic structures, physical properties and phase diagrams exposed through GUI and API.
datasets.count_scope: Structural counter only, not the sum of datasheets and physical-property records

sources.title: MPDS provider home
sources.evidence: Displays 424820 crystalline structures and distinct counters for 1101574 physical properties and 140255 phase diagrams.

sources.title: MPDS introduction
sources.evidence: Online PAULING FILE edition; subscription provides full data, with limited free and open subsets.

caveats: The platform additionally contains explicitly marked in-house calculated or ML data.
Free logged-in open access covers a limited subset; full GUI/API require subscription.
PAULING FILE-derived products overlap and must not be summed.

datasets.name: NIMS AtomWork

sources.title: NIMS MatNavi

datasets.name: NIMS AtomWork-Adv

sources.title: A comprehensive data network for data-driven study of battery materials
sources.evidence: Describes expert literature extraction and annual updating of AtomWork-Adv.

datasets.name: Starrydata2 experimental materials datasets

Composition and property data do not supply full periodic atomic structures.

Use the DOI of the actual version downloaded.

datasets.name: 3DSC_ICSD

sources.title: 3DSC_ICSD (only Tc and ICSD IDs) repository metadata
sources.evidence: Confirms public data deposit and its stated licence; applies to deposited files.

searches: 2026-11-01: official COD, ICSD, CCDC/CSD, Pearson Crystal Data, MPDS and ICDD release/access pages
2026-11-01: NIMS MatNavi, AtomWork/AtomWork-Adv, MDR SuperCon and MDR XAFS provider sources
2026-11-01: Starrydata project repository, live manifest and Figshare public metadata API; stored small snapshots
2026-11-01: Scientific Data descriptors for HTEM, 3DSC, synthesis, magnetic, thermoelectric, battery and quasicrystal datasets
2026-11-01: RRUFF/AMCSD, ROD, MAGNDATA and opXRD provider/author sources
2026-11-01: ACS Perspective coverage follow-up: DigBat/DDSE, DigHyd, Digital Hydrogen-S and Battery Archive
2026-11-01: Figshare version metadata checked for data licences; licences were not inferred from article licences
limitations: No massive data archives were downloaded; structure/record totals are provider- or author-reported unless explicitly identified as arithmetic sums.
Dataset counts use heterogeneous units and are not comparable as unique-material totals; overlapping databases and derivatives must not be summed.
Current primary count/licence unavailable for AMCSD and RRUFF; count left null and licence Not verified.
CSD count is the arithmetic sum of official January-2026 published-structure statistics; AtomWork count historical 2020; AtomWork-Adv count dated March 2026; HTEM count historical 2018.
ICSD total includes theoretical structures; ICDD includes mixed diffraction provenance; 3DSC labels/structures can be approximate matches.
Starrydata full and per-project totals overlap; raw sample rows are not deduplicated compositions. See archived manifest for project-specific counts.
HTEM hostname did not resolve; several portals had retrieval/TLS failures, recorded without bypassing authentication.
Digital Hydrogen-S portal certificate and publisher access prevented primary-content verification; listed as a resource with no numerical claim.
Many literature-property resources include noncrystalline samples or polymers; users must filter to their scientific scope.
Commercial/restricted and freely browsable services are distinguished from permissively licensed bulk data. Not verified is not a claim of unrestricted use.
